title: Primitive continuity is a closed current form that needs only orientation

statements.text: Primitive covariant continuity is the closedness $d\mathcal{J} = 0$ of a current three-form $\mathcal{J}$ on an oriented four-manifold. Stated this way, continuity needs only an orientation: no metric, no clock, no foliation and no observer.
statements.scope: the July 2026 refinement of the primitive, which places the conserved current one step above the root

sources.quote: Primitive covariant continuity is the closedness of the current form.
closed-form continuity itself requires only the orientation.
It does not select a chart, a foliation or an observer, and it does not require the current to be expressed first as a vector.
